$comment: Resource pack format numbers and release ranges are sourced from https://minecraft.wiki/w/Pack_format (release table).

notes: Data-driven item model definitions in assets/<namespace>/items/ replace model overrides.
The overrides field on models was removed.
Resin, eyeblossoms and GUI sprite changes.
Shader JSON program definitions for core shaders removed.
Core shader uniforms became uniform blocks.
Block model rotations no longer limited to 22.5 degree multiples.
oversized_in_gui item model field and player_head special model added.
New textures added; no breaking resource pack format changes.
Pack format now includes a minor version.
pack.mcmeta uses min_format and max_format; supported_formats is removed.
Some post-processing vertex shaders merged; OpenGL 3.3 required.
Sun and moon textures moved under environment/celestial/.
Item textures split out of the blocks atlas into a separate items atlas.
Block model multi-axis rotation and blockstate z rotation added.
mipmap_strategy replaces darkened_cutout_mipmap in texture mcmeta.
